''See also: [[Valin Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Valin, also known as the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]] or the [[Valinhall Incarnation|Incarnation of Valinhall]], is the founder of the [[Valinhall]] [[Territory]]. Originally a human, he arrived in [[the House]] via a sudden flash of light and sound, appearing as if cast from another realm. He eventually claimed [[the House]] as his own, naming it [[Valinhall]], and utilized his knowledge and collected texts to create a Gate connecting his world to others. Valin's history is tied to a conflict with [[Damasca]], where he turned the [[Territory]]'s power against him. While once an [[Incarnation]], he has since transitioned into a role as a [[room guardian]], though his power fluctuates based on the presence of [[Travelers]]. Physically, Valin is described as a striking and somewhat grotesque figure. He possesses solid black eyes with gleaming metallic silver irises, and his body is marked by [[black chains]] that wrap around his head, chest, and arms. He often appears in stained or tattered clothing, sometimes appearing bare-chested with a bald, chain-marked scalp. In combat, he is highly skilled, utilizing speed and power with various blades, including a gold-and-silver sword. As the founder, he is deeply connected to the [[Territory]]; as he moves, the environment often reshapes itself into structures resembling [[Valinhall]]. He is characterized by a restless nature and a profound appreciation for the skill and life-risking nature of combat.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Valin is a man covered in [[black chains]] that writhe across his skin like snakes, with a coil of [[Shadow|shadow]] or smoke wrapped around his ankles. His eyes are solid black without whites, featuring gleaming metallic silver or [[steel]]-colored irises. He is also seen carrying a dagger, short swords, and a gold-and-silver blade.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Known as the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]], Valin has expressed a joy for battle and would attack others to test their strength. He previously sought to end human sacrifice before changing his mind, and he holds a hatred for [[Talos]]'s father. As a former master to [[Kai]], he once raised twelve students with the goal of bringing down [[Damasca]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Valin can draw upon [[Nye essence]], allowing him to move with the speed of [[the Nye]]. He possesses a wound that can knit itself whole using a bright green light. His combat repertoire includes the use of [[Mithra]], [[Dragon's Fang]], and a sword that can be utilized in a three-part combination.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Creation of Valinhall}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Valin gave [[the House]] its name, [[Valinhall]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c9">''House of Blades'', chapter 9</ref> He also fashioned a key designed to open a Gate connecting his world to [[Valinhall]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c9" /> Although he initially intended to end the practice of human sacrifice, Valin eventually changed his mind.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c11">''House of Blades'', chapter 11</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The Wanderer}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Known as the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]] and the [[Valinhall Incarnation|Incarnation of Valinhall]], Valin forged [[Mithra]] and slew King [[Zakareth the Fifth]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 4</ref> After being sealed away for twenty-five years following a fight with [[Kai]], this former master of [[Kai]] is finally free.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c18">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 18</ref> As the first [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]], he was the first of his group to fall.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c5">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 9</ref> Now a man covered in [[black chains]] that writhe like snakes, Valin possesses eyes with solid black whites and gleaming silver irises.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c11">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 11</ref> He is a looming threat to [[Simon]], who has been tasked with intercepting him alongside [[Indirial]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c14">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 14</ref> During combat, Valin fights evenly with [[Indirial]] and moves with the speed of [[the Nye]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c11" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c12">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c14" /> He utilizes a gold-and-silver sword and a weapon called [[Dragon's Fang]], while his wounds can knit themselves whole with a bright green light.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c11" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c12" />}}
